themes.heading: SingleView v9 to v12 upgrade
points: Led the platform upgrade across 14 countries covering millions of accounts, with an 8-person team per upgrade, delivered within a planned 6-hour downtime window.

themes.heading: Starlink integration
points: Delivered the Starlink integration deployment across 9 countries within 3 weeks; demoed it to CSRs and OPCO clients and replicated it across the other OPCOs. Recently launched, with tens of customers onboarded so far.

themes.heading: Billing migration
points: Migrated ~400 enterprise customers and ~2,500 services, including balances, from manual to automated billing with no downtime.

points: Built a reusable, configuration-driven outbound REST API framework that nearly all current and all new REST APIs are built on. New APIs are set up through configuration instead of writing new functions each time. Developed 5 production APIs for enterprise integrations.

themes.heading: Operations and customer delivery
points: Developed real-time customer notifications and an automated email reminder system used by enterprise customers across multiple regions.
Built SQL-based reporting and automation for billing operations, giving the operations team ready-made reports so they no longer write and maintain their own SQL queries.
Streamlined invoice generation and balance confirmation workflows through process automation.
Worked directly with enterprise customers to resolve production issues through root cause analysis, and provided technical consultation.
Implemented 6 customer-driven product enhancements to the platform.
